turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We're building raised beds this weekend. Wood or metal?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Wood looks natural and is cheaper, metal lasts longer and warms up faster in spring. What matters more to you, budget or durability?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold on, I need to talk to my roommate for a second. Stay quiet until I say I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ethan, did you take the blue pieces? I'm missing two.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: No, I'm red. Check under the board.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Found one. Where's the other one?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Maybe the dog took it again.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh no. Can we use a coin instead for now?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Sure, a coin is fine. Your turn, by the way.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ethan, did you call the landlord?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Not yet, I'll do it tonight.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm back, sorry for the wait.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. Still weighing up wood against metal?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Budget, so let's go with wood.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good. Use untreated larch or cedar if you can, they resist rot without any chemicals.
